steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction; sealed-bid strategy is not directly supported by this step.

args.goal: change the auction strategy to Sealed bid and leave the configuration showing the selected sealed-bid strategy

steps.note: Use the buyer screen to attempt the sealed-bid configuration that has no dedicated catalog step.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Select the first available auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Populate the pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Verify the requested location was retained in the sheet.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Inspect the invited vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify that the inspected vendor does not see a rank before the auction ends.
Return to the buyer console before requesting the missing second-vendor check.

args.need: open the second invited vendor's own supplier-portal session and verify that it cannot see the other vendor's price or rank before the auction ends

steps.note: A second vendor session is not available through the catalog.
Confirm no application error was shown during the visibility checks.
